name: visa-bulletin-push
description: Free US Visa Bulletin alerts for China and India EB-1, EB-2 and EB-3: a web page, JSON API, signed webhooks, an Atom feed and an MCP server on one Cloudflare Worker (free plan).

INGEST_SECRET.description: Signs manual corrections (`POST /v1/ingest`) and on-demand polls. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

TOKEN_ENC_KEY.description: Encrypts stored webhook secrets (AES-GCM). Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`. Changing it later makes existing webhook subscriptions undeliverable.

IP_HASH_SALT.description: Optional. Salt for the one-way IP hash used to limit webhook sign-ups. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 16`.
